entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A human artificer and planeswalker of Dominaria known for his millennia-long struggle with Yawgmoth and Phyrexia, who died activating the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's younger brother, who became corrupted by Phyrexian influence and was destroyed in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: An archaeologist, friend of the brothers' father, who taught Urza and Mishra and died inadvertently during the Brotherhood's End.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The Warlord of Kroog's daughter, whom Urza married to obtain a Thran tome.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's student and friend, creator of triskelions and tetravuses.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Urza's future student, who learned how to activate the Sylex from him, later a student at the Academy.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The demonic ruler of Phyrexia and Urza's great enemy.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon who corrupted Mishra and was defeated by Urza at Koilos.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian Newt, turned from sleeper agent into servant, who became Urza's assistant and died at Koilos.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A young Dominarian recruited to impersonate Mishra for Urza, later Xantcha's lover, killed at Koilos.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem Urza created with Xantcha's heartstone, who took up Urza's staff after the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A Tolarian Academy mage who argued against the soul bombs and saved Urza from Yavimaya.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: A Phyrexian sleeper agent who led Negators trapped in fast time on Tolaria and was destroyed by Urza and Multani.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A Yavimaya elemental who trapped Urza, then became trapped in him and later aided him.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: The Maro Elemental of Argoth, whose pain Urza was forced to experience.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The planeswalker of Serra's Realm who healed Urza.

entities.name: Tevash Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker among the Nine Titans who betrayed his fellows to the Phyrexians and was killed by Urza.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Commander of the Weatherlight who beheaded Urza in the Phyrexian Arena and later died activating the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: One of Yawgmoth's generals who led Phyrexian troops during the Invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Urza's home plane.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane ruled by Yawgmoth, Urza's lifelong enemy.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: An artificial plane Yawgmoth overlaid upon Dominaria as a portal for his armies.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The magical school Urza founded on the island of Tolaria, damaged by the Tolarian Temporal Disaster.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: A cave of Thran artifacts containing the sealed gateway to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A sub-continent sunk by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest that held deep hatred of Urza for destroying Argoth.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A plane overrun by Phyrexians whose energies Urza used to power the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The decades-long war between Urza's Yotia and Mishra's Fallaji, ending at Argoth.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An ancient Thran device whose blast ended the Brothers' War and sank Argoth.

entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: The two halves of the powerstone that sealed Phyrexia; they became Urza's eyes.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A flying ship built by Urza as the lynchpin of his battle plan against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: The weapon assembled from artifacts, Urza's stones, Karn's body and Gerrard's life that destroyed Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Artificial humanoids Urza created to emulate Phyrexian physiology and resist the invasion.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Nine planeswalkers who piloted huge artifact Titan Engines built by Urza to attack Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Yawgmoth's invasion of Dominaria through the Caves of Koilos and Rath.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast that slaughtered both armies at Argoth, sank the sub-continent and led to the Ice Age.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The explosion of Urza's time machine that destroyed most of the Academy.

entities.name: Starfield Orb
entities.description: A failsafe Urza hid in the Tivan Desert containing contingencies for Teferi.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra are sent to Tocasia's archaeological dig after their father falls ill.
events.quote: he sent them away to his old friend, Tocasia , to serve as students at her archaeological dig

events.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers break the powerstone sealing Phyrexia in two, and Tocasia dies inadvertently in the resulting Brotherhood's End.
events.quote: in their haste to grab the stone before the other brother, they broke it in two

events.summary: Urza builds a machine to move a jade statue and wins Kayla bin-Kroog's hand to obtain a Thran tome, then becomes Chief Artificer.
events.quote: Urza built a gigantic machine to move the statue.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra's kingdoms fight the Brothers' War, with Kroog falling and machines escalating the conflict for decades.
events.quote: It continued for decades until the fateful day at Argoth when the brothers met face to face at the head of their armies.

events.summary: At Argoth Urza discovers Mishra has been corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
events.quote: Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence, slowly turning himself from a man into a living machine

events.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, destroying both armies, sinking Argoth and leading to the Ice Age.
events.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles around, sank the sub-continent Argoth

events.summary: At the moment of the blast Urza meets Teferi beyond time, his body is remade with the Mightstone and Weakstone as eyes, and his spark ignites.
events.quote: igniting his latent planeswalker spark

events.summary: Six years later Urza returns to say farewell to Tawnos and asks him to return to Kayla.
events.quote: Urza returned to Dominaria to say a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

events.summary: Urza realizes Gix corrupted Mishra, beginning his lifelong hunt for retribution against Phyrexia and Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza came to realize that Mishra had been completely corrupted by Gix

events.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia, blasts a hole down to the 4th Sphere, but Yawgmoth invades his mind and drives him further insane.
events.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane

events.summary: Urza flees from plane to plane, visits Zendikar and is healed by Serra, after which the Phyrexians corrupt her realm.
events.quote: Urza came to Serra's Realm and was healed by Serra

events.summary: Xantcha brings Ratepe to impersonate Mishra to shock Urza out of his guilt.
events.quote: Ratepe was able to help shock Urza out of his guilt.

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe are killed when Urza fights Gix in Koilos; the sacrifice helps Urza defeat Gix.
events.quote: Both Ratepe and Xantcha were killed when Urza fought the Phyrexian Demon Gix in Koilos .

events.summary: Urza founds the Tolarian Academy as Master Malzra, gathering talented scholars including Barrin, Teferi and Rayne.
events.quote: Under the pseudonym "Master Malzra," Urza summoned the most talented artificers

events.summary: Urza creates Karn by implanting Xantcha's heartstone in a silver golem.
events.quote: By implanting Xantcha's heartstone (her only remains) into a silver golem , Urza created Karn

events.summary: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroys most of the Academy and kills hundreds after Karn is sent back to prevent a Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroyed the majority of the Tolarian Academy, killing hundreds of inhabitants

events.summary: Urza rebuilds the Academy and uses its temporal rifts for fast-time research.
events.quote: Urza eventually rebuilt the Academy

events.summary: Multani traps Urza in a magnigoth tree at Yavimaya and forces him to feel Titania's pain.
events.quote: trapped Urza in a magnigoth tree and forced him to experience all the pain Titania

events.summary: Barrin saves Urza, Multani becomes trapped within him, and Multani later helps destroy Kerrick and his Negators during the Invasion of Tolaria.
events.quote: Multani aided Urza in destroying Kerrick and all his minions

events.summary: Urza builds the Weatherlight and sacrifices the energies of Serra's Realm to power it.
events.quote: Urza decided to use the energies of the collapsing Phyrexian-overrun plane of Serra's Realm

events.summary: Urza creates the Metathran to resist the Rath overlay and Yawgmoth's coming invasion.
events.quote: Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

events.summary: Dominaria's forces unite to push Yawgmoth back during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: All of the forces of Dominaria banded against Yawgmoth and tried to push him back.

events.summary: Urza's Nine Titans enter Phyrexia, but Tevash Szat betrays and kills his fellow planeswalkers until Urza defeats him and uses his life force for soul bombs.
events.quote: Tevash Szat began to betray and kill his fellow planeswalkers, turning to the side of the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Fascinated by Phyrexia's artificial nature, Urza dismantles the master soul bomb and surrenders to Yawgmoth.
events.quote: he dismantled the master soul bomb

events.summary: Gerrard beheads Urza in the Phyrexian Arena and is crowned Yawgmoth's champion.
events.quote: Gerrard beheaded Urza and was crowned as Yawgmoth's new champion.

events.summary: Gerrard escapes Phyrexia carrying Urza's severed head, which speaks to him.
events.quote: he was shocked to hear the head of Urza address him

events.summary: Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a Black Cloud of Death; Urza reveals the final secret of the Legacy Weapon.
events.quote: Urza told the crew the final secret of the Legacy Weapon .

events.summary: Urza and Gerrard die activating the Legacy Weapon, which destroys Yawgmoth; Karn takes up Urza's staff and leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: Urza and Gerrard died in the activation, but the weapon successfully destroyed Yawgmoth.

relations.quote: Urza and his younger brother Mishra were born on the first and last days of the same year

relations.note: She taught the brothers about Thran artifacts.
relations.quote: Under Tocasia's guidance, the two brothers learned a large amount about the manufacture of artifacts

relations.note: He married her though he was not affectionate towards her.
relations.quote: He succeeded and was wed to Kayla bin-Kroog .
At the moment of the blast, Urza met his future student Teferi Akosa in a moment beyond time.

relations.note: Tawnos is called his student and good friend.
relations.quote: his student and good friend Tawnos

relations.note: Urza hunted Phyrexia and its ruler for retribution.
relations.quote: lifelong hunt for retribution against Phyrexia and its demonic ruler, Yawgmoth.

relations.note: Urza destroyed his brother with the Sylex.
relations.quote: After he had destroyed his brother
Mishra had been completely corrupted by Gix

relations.note: Urza created Karn from a silver golem and Xantcha's heartstone.
He founded and headed the Academy as Master Malzra.
relations.quote: Urza created a vast school of magic and technology on the island of Tolaria

relations.note: He christened the ship Skyship Weatherlight.
relations.quote: Urza christened the ship Skyship Weatherlight .

relations.note: He created them to resist the Phyrexian invasion.
Urza defeated Tevash and used his life force for the soul bombs.
relations.quote: Urza was able to defeat him and used the power from his life force

relations.note: Gerrard beheaded Urza in the Phyrexian Arena.
The Legacy Weapon activated by Urza and Gerrard destroyed Yawgmoth.

relations.quote: Tsabo Tavoc , one of Yawgmoth's generals
